title: Depression and Discouragement
definition: Depression and discouragement refer to deep sorrow, heaviness, weariness, and loss of heart that may affect a person's emotions, thoughts, body, and faith.
summary: Scripture does not shame the downcast. It gives space for lament, prayer, help, community, truth, and hope in God. The suffering believer is invited to bring sorrow honestly before the Lord.
christFocus: Christ is gentle with the weary and gives rest to burdened souls.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Scripture does not shame the downcast. It gives space for lament, prayer, help, community, truth, and hope in God. The suffering believer is invited to bring sorrow honestly before the Lord.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
